name: pharos_session_shape
description: One row per agent session (a recorded conversation; a delegated sub-agent run is its own session): its shape, velocity and forensic signals, from message timestamps, Human Words authorship and the tool ledger. A value without enough evidence is empty, never zero. Mirrors and aliases are counted once. See docs/session-shape.md.

fields.name: started_at
fields.label: Started
fields.description: Time of the session's first timestamped message. Sessions without timestamps have none and fall outside every date range.

fields.name: last_message_at
fields.label: Last message
fields.description: Time of the session's last timestamped message: the last time you or the agent wrote in it. Empty without timestamps.

fields.name: day
fields.label: Day
fields.description: Local date the session started.

fields.name: conversation_id
fields.label: Conversation ID
fields.description: The agent session: one recorded conversation. A delegated sub-agent run is its own session.

fields.name: root_conversation_id
fields.label: Top-level conversation ID
fields.description: Recorded top-level conversation including nested agents, linked launches, and continuations, as in Usage. Unresolved parent chains are unavailable.

fields.name: title
fields.label: Workspace
fields.description: Title of the session's workspace.

fields.name: repository_name
fields.label: Repository
fields.description: Repository of the session's workspace; empty when none is recorded.

fields.name: harness
fields.label: Harness
fields.description: The app that ran the session.

fields.name: model
fields.label: Model (reported)
fields.description: The session's recorded model.

fields.name: model_family
fields.label: Model
fields.description: The session's recorded model, by family.

fields.name: effort
fields.label: Effort
fields.description: Recorded agent effort level; unavailable when the source does not report it.

fields.name: agent_depth
fields.label: Agent depth
fields.description: 0 for a top-level session; delegated runs are 1 or more, even when their transcript records depth 0.

fields.name: agent_kind
fields.label: Agent kind
fields.description: Whether the session is a top-level session or a delegated run.

fields.name: channel
fields.label: Channel
fields.description: Initiating channel, inherited through the entire task tree.

fields.name: machine_id
fields.label: Machine
fields.description: Initiating location, inherited through the task tree; execution location is separate.

fields.name: machine
fields.label: Machine name
fields.description: Recorded task origin metadata.

fields.name: machine_kind
fields.label: Machine kind
fields.description: Recorded task origin metadata.

fields.name: execution_machine_id
fields.label: Execution machine
fields.description: Recorded task origin metadata.

fields.name: execution_machine
fields.label: Execution machine name
fields.description: Recorded task origin metadata.

fields.name: execution_machine_kind
fields.label: Execution machine kind
fields.description: Recorded task origin metadata.

fields.name: channel_status
fields.label: Channel status
fields.description: How the channel was established.

fields.name: machine_status
fields.label: Machine status
fields.description: How the machine was established.

fields.name: execution_machine_status
fields.label: Execution machine status
fields.description: How the execution machine was established.

fields.name: origin_conversation_id
fields.label: Origin conversation
fields.description: The conversation the origin was inherited from.

fields.name: origin_evidence
fields.label: Origin evidence
fields.description: Recorded task origin metadata.

fields.name: channels
fields.label: Channels
fields.description: The session's channel, or Unknown.

fields.name: machines
fields.label: Machines
fields.description: The session's machine, or Unknown.

fields.name: execution_machines
fields.label: Execution machines
fields.description: The session's execution machine, or Unknown.

fields.name: messages
fields.label: Messages
fields.description: The session's own messages: prompts, responses, reasoning, tool calls and results; metadata events are left out. An embedded sub-agent's messages are its own.

fields.name: typed_human_messages
fields.label: Typed human messages
fields.description: User messages holding text the person typed (Human Words). Pasted, quoted, re-sent, template, harness and automated text does not count. Empty without authorship.

fields.name: typed_words
fields.label: Typed words
fields.description: Words the person typed across the session's typed human messages (Human Words). Pasted, quoted, re-sent, template, harness and automated text does not count. Empty without authorship.

fields.name: tool_calls
fields.label: Tool calls
fields.description: The session's own tool calls. Empty when the tool ledger does not cover the session.

fields.name: wall_seconds
fields.label: Wall time (s)
fields.description: Last message time minus first.

fields.name: active_seconds
fields.label: Active time (s)
fields.description: Sum of the gaps between consecutive messages of 300 seconds or less; a longer gap counts as zero.

fields.name: idle_seconds
fields.label: Idle time (s)
fields.description: Wall time minus active time.

fields.name: active_hours
fields.label: Active hours
fields.description: Active time in hours.

fields.name: autonomy
fields.label: Tool calls per typed message
fields.description: Tool calls per typed human message: tool calls ÷ max(1, typed human messages). Pool it as Σ tool calls ÷ Σ autonomy prompts.

fields.name: autonomy_prompts
fields.label: Typed messages (at least 1)
fields.description: max(1, typed human messages): autonomy's denominator, for pooling.

fields.name: turn_cycles
fields.label: Timed turns
fields.description: Typed human messages answered by an assistant message within 1,800 seconds.

fields.name: turn_cycle_p50_seconds
fields.label: Turn cycle p50 (s)
fields.description: Median gap from a typed human message to the next assistant message, over gaps of 1,800 seconds or less.

fields.name: turn_cycle_p90_seconds
fields.label: Turn cycle p90 (s)
fields.description: 90th percentile of the same gaps.

fields.name: first_response_seconds
fields.label: First response (s)
fields.description: The same gap for the first typed human message only.

fields.name: max_unprompted_tool_calls
fields.label: Longest unprompted run
fields.description: The longest run of tool calls with no typed human message between them.

fields.name: files_edited
fields.label: Files edited
fields.description: Distinct files touched by edit-family tools that did not fail.

fields.name: subagents
fields.label: Sub-agents
fields.description: Delegated runs the session launched: embedded and linked sub-agent sessions, and headless agent runs its shell commands started.

fields.name: compactions
fields.label: Compactions
fields.description: Compaction markers, as the Library counts them.

fields.name: input_tokens
fields.label: Input tokens
fields.description: The session's input tokens from Usage, cached input included.

fields.name: output_tokens
fields.label: Output tokens
fields.description: The session's output tokens from Usage.

fields.name: cost_usd
fields.label: Cost (API $)
fields.description: API-equivalent cost of the session's usage, priced as Usage prices it.

fields.name: length_band
fields.label: Length band
fields.description: Messages, in AgentsView's bands.

fields.name: active_band
fields.label: Active time band
fields.description: Active time, in AgentsView's duration bands.

fields.name: tool_band
fields.label: Tool call band
fields.description: Tool calls, in Splitrail's bands.

fields.name: autonomy_band
fields.label: Calls per typed message band
fields.description: Autonomy, in AgentsView's AutonomyBucket edges.

fields.name: archetype
fields.label: Archetype
fields.description: Automated: no typed human message. Otherwise by typed human messages: Quick 5 or fewer, Standard 15 or fewer, Deep 50 or fewer, Marathon more.

fields.name: failed_calls
fields.label: Failed calls
fields.description: Calls with status error, other than a user rejection, an interrupt or a hook block. Empty without enough evidence.

fields.name: rejections
fields.label: Rejections
fields.description: Calls the user rejected (error type user_rejected). Empty without enough evidence.

fields.name: interrupts
fields.label: Interrupts
fields.description: Calls interrupted by the user or harness. Empty without enough evidence.

fields.name: hook_blocks
fields.label: Hook blocks
fields.description: Calls a hook blocked (error type hook_blocked). Empty without enough evidence.

fields.name: failure_streak_max
fields.label: Longest failure streak
fields.description: Longest run of consecutive failed calls. Empty without enough evidence.

fields.name: identical_retries
fields.label: Identical retries
fields.description: Runs of 3 or more consecutive calls with the same tool and byte-identical input; each run adds its length less one. Empty without enough evidence.

fields.name: thrash_retries
fields.label: Edit-test-edit retries
fields.description: Within one human turn, an edit to a file, then a test, build or lint command, then another edit to that file. Empty without enough evidence.

fields.name: edit_turns
fields.label: Edit turns
fields.description: Human turns with an edit. Empty without enough evidence.

fields.name: one_shot_edit_turns
fields.label: One-shot edit turns
fields.description: Edit turns without an edit-test-edit retry. Empty without enough evidence.

fields.name: churned_files
fields.label: Churned files
fields.description: Files with 3 or more edits whose message positions span fewer than 10. Empty without enough evidence.

fields.name: mid_task_compactions
fields.label: Mid-task compactions
fields.description: Compactions where 2 or more distinct tool names appear both in the 10 calls before and the 5 after. Empty without enough evidence.

fields.name: context_peak_tokens
fields.label: Peak context (tokens)
fields.description: Largest request input, cached input included, in the session's own stream. Empty without enough evidence.

fields.name: context_window
fields.label: Context window
fields.description: The reported window, else a Claude model's 200K or 1M as the reader's context rail infers it. Empty when unknown.

fields.name: context_pressure
fields.label: Context pressure
fields.description: 1 when peak context exceeded 90% of the window, else 0. Empty when the window is unknown.

fields.name: corrections
fields.label: Corrections
fields.description: Typed human messages with a correction cue (Human Words). Empty without enough evidence.

fields.name: verified_handbacks
fields.label: Verified handbacks
fields.description: Handbacks after an edit where a test, build or lint command ran after the last edit. Empty without enough evidence.

fields.name: edit_handbacks
fields.label: Edit handbacks
fields.description: Assistant handbacks to the human (the last assistant message of a turn) that follow an edit. Empty without enough evidence.

fields.name: unverified_handbacks
fields.label: Unverified handbacks
fields.description: Edit handbacks without a verification after the last edit. Empty without enough evidence.

fields.name: ended_on_failure
fields.label: Ended on a failed call
fields.description: Experimental: 1 when the session's last tool call failed and nothing human-typed follows. Empty without enough evidence.

fields.name: long_unprompted_runs
fields.label: Long unprompted runs
fields.description: Runs of 150 or more tool calls with no typed human message. Empty without enough evidence.

fields.name: forensic_events
fields.label: Forensic events
fields.description: Sum of the session's forensic counts: failed calls, retries, churn, mid-task compactions, context pressure, corrections, interrupts, rejections, hook blocks, unverified handbacks, an ended-on-failure and long runs. Empty without enough evidence.

fields.name: context_peak_ratio
fields.label: Peak context share
fields.description: Peak context ÷ the context window, as a fraction. Empty, not zero, when the window is unknown.

fields.name: has_tool_data
fields.label: Tool data
fields.description: The tool ledger covers the session (or it made no tool calls).

fields.name: has_timestamps
fields.label: Timestamps
fields.description: The session's messages carry timestamps.

fields.name: has_authorship
fields.label: Authorship
fields.description: Human Words has classified the session's user messages (or it has none).

fields.name: has_context_window
fields.label: Context window known
fields.description: Peak context and the window are both known.
